mappings.reason: Same statute: the Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Amendment Act, 2020 (Lok Sabha 2020-09-21, Rajya Sabha 2020-09-23, in force 2020-09-29). Neither id is in the inventory and each is used by one file, so the first file in name order (fcra-actions.json) keeps its id. Rewritten in the raw file (entity id and claim fcra-receipts:c059 s); fcra-receipts.json keeps a minimal copy because c059 needs it, and the full record (aliases, facts, sources) lives in fcra-actions.json.

Same population: the associations holding FCRA registration, used as the denominator/counter-party node. ngo:fcra-associations-aggregate is used by two files (donors-narratives.json, fcra-receipts.json), ngo:fcra-registered-associations by one (fcra-actions.json), so the id used by most files survives (this reverses the direction of the earlier partial reconciliation, which had not rewritten the raw files). Rewritten in fcra-actions.json (entity id and 13 claim endpoints: c006-c016, c018, c099); its aliases 'FCRA NGOs' and 'FCRA associations' moved to the full record in fcra-receipts.json, which alone now carries aliases.

refusedMerges.reason: Two registered bodies of the Ekal movement (the umbrella trust and the EVFI foundation) with separate registrations and separate claims (Gandhi Peace Prize vs FC receipts); a shared name is not identity.
Vivekananda Kendra, Kanyakumari (TN) founded VIF (Delhi, 2009) but they are separate legal entities with separate offices; name similarity alone.
Separate trusts with separate FCRA registrations, each cancelled by its own order (fcra-actions:c055, c056).
RGICS is a think tank promoted by RGF with its own donor list (political-trusts:c009); promoter is not identity.
Different trust, different purpose; common trustees are recorded as role edges, not as one entity.
Foreign donor (US) vs Indian recipient association; the grant edge between them (fcra-receipts:c028, c031) would collapse into a self-loop.
US donor vs Indian partner association (CEI, WB); separate FCRA actions (fcra-receipts:c036 vs c038).
Foreign donor (HK/US) vs Indian recipient trust; 'Gospel for Asia India' is an alias of the Indian trust, not of the donor.
Related Kerala bodies named in one 2017 MHA action but separately registered associations.
Successive statutes (1976 Act repealed by the 2010 Act from 2011-05-01); the 2014 Delhi HC finding applies the 1976 Act.
A pending Bill and notified Rules are different instruments with different dates.
Act of Parliament vs subordinate rules (GSR 506(E)).
The FCRA wing is a division of the ministry; fcra-actions.json attributes orders to the division, other files to the ministry. Kept apart: merging would erase which files name the issuing unit.
Deendayal Research Institute (DRI, an association) vs the Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI, an agency) — acronym collision only; the ambiguous alias 'DRI' was removed from the association.
Acronym collision on 'MoC' only; the alias was removed from the Ministry of Culture.
ICAR is a registered society under DARE, not the ministry; the alias 'ICAR' was removed from the ministry (finance fleet owns fin:icar; darpan-welfare-join:c042 stays at ministry level).
The Tata Trusts are charitable trusts that own most of Tata Sons; an owner is not the group it owns.
The Atlas node 'agencies' is ED · CBI · IT Dept; the IB is a different agency.
Two different Singhs: R.P.N. Singh (MoS Home, UPA-II, in office 2013-12-18) vs Rajnath Singh (Home Minister 2014-05-26 to 2019-05-30); offices and dates differ.
Two different Singhs: MoS Home vs Prime Minister 2004-2014.
Father and son are different persons with different public roles (NSA / VIF founding director vs India Foundation / BJP Uttarakhand); each carries his own role edges and no family edge is drawn.
Same person, but both ids are in the inventory; this fleet uses the pol: id and reconciling the inventory duplicate is outside the ngo fleet.
Same institution defined by the capital fleet under cap:; cross-fleet reconciliation is outside the ngo fleet (only raw/ngo files may be edited) — flagged for the capital editor or the fleet merge.
